title: Design System: Pragati Srivastava — The Practical File

kraft.purpose: File cover and page ground, top bar, punch holes, browser canvas.

kraft-deep.purpose: Scrollbar thumb on the kraft track.

paper.purpose: Every sheet, chip, paper button and icon link.

margin-red.purpose: Printed margin line and the examiner's pen strokes.

examiner-red.purpose: Red stamp button, mail button, wordmark period, crash lines, focus ring.

remark-red.purpose: Handwritten examiner remarks set as text.

ballpoint-blue.purpose: Her handwriting and every interactive affordance.

ink-wash.purpose: Hover fill of paper controls; correct answer fill.

violet-wash.purpose: Fill of a port held by another process.

graph-paper.purpose: Graph paper ground (NASA record and certificate).

outline-brown.purpose: 1.5px outline of every object; frames; table head rules.

highlighter.purpose: Text selection and Index hover sweep.

tape.purpose: Photo tape, at 72% opacity with a faint brown edge.

display.purpose: PRACTICAL FILE and INDEX only. Uppercase, Archivo width 68%.

headline.purpose: Record and Annexure titles, max 20ch. Uppercase.

title.purpose: Practical frame titles, certificate titles, sub-sheets. Uppercase; 1.6rem below sm.

body.purpose: Record text; line-height equals the rule gap; max 68ch.

label.purpose: Printed field labels (Name, Aim, Result, Date, Sign). Uppercase, print-soft.

hand.purpose: Her handwritten entries: Index, values, dates, step numbers. Ballpoint blue.

hand-name.purpose: Her name on the front-page label; writes itself on once.

button-stamp.purpose: The email call to action. Uppercase.

motion.name: ease-place
motion.purpose: Placed: sheets slide up 18–28px and settle rotation over 0.8–0.95s; also collapse, end cards, meters.

motion.name: ease-pen
motion.purpose: Written: ink strokes draw by path length. Tick 0.45s, cross 0.4s, signature 1.4s.

motion.name: ease-write-on
motion.purpose: Name clip reveal, 1.1s, 0.45s delay, once on load.

motion.name: spring-stamp
motion.purpose: Pressed: stamps and the red stamp button land from a larger scale and steeper angle.

motion.name: spring-switch
motion.purpose: Fair copy / Rough work active segment slides.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Hover and press transitions on buttons and links.

motion.name: duration-highlight
motion.purpose: Highlighter sweep behind an Index entry.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" + global CSS duration clamp

browserSurfaces.name: canvas
browserSurfaces.purpose: Overscroll and canvas match the kraft cover.

browserSurfaces.name: focus
browserSurfaces.purpose: Examiner red focus ring on every focusable element.

materials.name: kraft-fibre
materials.value: fractal noise SVG (baseFrequency .85, 3 octaves) over two hairline repeating gradients at 94deg and -3deg

materials.name: ruling
materials.value: 1px #9cc3e4 line every rule gap (2rem records, 2.75rem Index, 1.75rem slip); offset -0.45rem in writing areas
materials.purpose: Ruled paper; text sits on the rule.

materials.name: graph
materials.purpose: Graph paper, NASA record and certificate only.

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a B.Tech practical file laid open on a desk. A fibrous kraft cover is the ground. White sheets sit on it, ruled in pale blue with a red margin, punched for binding, and joined by tape and staples. Every piece of work is an experiment record with Aim, Apparatus, Procedure (or Observation) and Result. The visitor is the examiner: a red pen ticks each record in the Index as it is read, and the viva earns the examiner's signature.

The world speaks in four inks, and each ink has one job. Printed-form black is the institution: condensed uppercase Archivo for headings and field labels. Ballpoint blue is Pragati's own hand: Kalam for the entries she writes, and the colour of every interactive affordance she offers. Examiner red is the visitor's pen and the one call to action. Violet is the rubber stamp that records status. Monospace appears only where a terminal would print: code, ports and printouts.

Depth is physical but flat. Sheets are outlined in a dark brown line, turned a fraction of a degree, and placed on the desk with motion. Nothing casts a shadow. The density is that of a real record book: one line of writing per ruled line, generous margins, and short sheets that a recruiter can scan in ten seconds while an engineer can switch to "Rough work" for every step.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft cover ground with procedural fibre noise; white sheets on top.
Writing sits on the rules: body line-height equals the rule gap.
Four inks with fixed jobs: print, ballpoint blue, examiner red, stamp violet.
Outlined objects, slight rotations, no cast shadows.
Motion grammar: sheets placed, ink that writes, stamps that press.
Two reading depths: Fair copy (short) and Rough work (every detail).

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Print black is the form, ballpoint blue is her voice and her controls, red is the examiner, violet is status. Never give a colour a second job.

rules.name: The Examiner's Pen Rule
rules.body: Red appears only where an examiner would put a pen, where the paper prints its margin, where something fails, and on the single action to email her. Red is never decoration, body text, a heading, or a status label.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Any state that a clerk would stamp (merged, deployed, nominated, verified, graded) is a violet rubber stamp. Status is never a coloured pill or a green badge.

rules.name: The Filled-In Form Rule
rules.body: Printed condensed caps ask; Kalam answers. A label is always printed, and the value that a student would write by hand is always Kalam in ballpoint blue.

rules.name: The Terminal Only Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for what a machine prints: port numbers, printout lines, code. Never use it for labels, metadata, dates or decoration.

rules.name: The Outlined Object Rule
rules.body: Every object is outlined, not lifted. A sheet, button, chip, photo or input gets a 1.25–2.5px outline-brown border; a soft or offset drop shadow never appears. (An inset 2px line under the Index table head is a drawn rule, not a shadow.)

rules.name: The Desk Rule
rules.body: Sheets lie on the desk at a slight angle and settle when placed. Rotation stays under 3°, and content inside a sheet is never rotated except stamps, remarks and attached certificates.

dos: Do set every line of record text on a rule: line-height equals the rule gap (2rem in records, 2.75rem in the Index), and field spacing is one rule.
Do write labels in the printed voice (Archivo 600, width 80%, uppercase, 0.72rem) and her values in Kalam ballpoint blue.
Do outline every object with a 1.5px outline-brown border and place sheets at under 3° of rotation.
Do keep one red stamp button per context, and make it email Pragati.
Do record status as a violet rubber stamp with the noise mask.
Do end every practical on a red-ink remark and the red stamp button.
Do state what is simulated in the practical frame's note.
Do animate with the three verbs only: placed, written, pressed.
donts: Don't use a cast or offset shadow on anything. Depth is outline, overlap and material.
Don't use red for body text, headings, decoration or status. Red is the examiner's pen, the printed margin, a failure, the focus ring and the email action.
Don't use violet for anything that is not a status stamp.
Don't use monospace for labels, dates, metadata or decoration; it is for code, ports and printouts only.
Don't set Kalam for printed form text, or printed caps for her handwritten entries.
Don't use graph paper except for the NASA record and its certificate.
Don't round sheets or buttons beyond 4px; only chips are pills.
